headline: Apple's MacBook Pro line reportedly set to gain touchscreens
summary: Apple is reportedly bringing a touchscreen to its MacBook Pro line. One outlet writes as though the touchscreen MacBook Pro already exists, while the other frames it as a future rollout still based on unconfirmed reports.

claims.statement: Apple is set to add touchscreens to its premium MacBook Pro laptops.

sources.quote: Apple is introducing a touchscreen laptop in the MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR Display.
New reports indicate the touchscreens are to become the standard on premium MacBook Pros.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet reports Apple has already introduced a touchscreen MacBook Pro, while the other describes it only as a reported future rollout.

quotes.quote: Apple finally has a touchscreen MacBook.
Don’t want a touchscreen? All premium MacBook Pros could have one soon, reports say
